parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter for non-null efo_id and non-null efo_term. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
